'''Ventress' ship''' was the personal [[starfighter]] of [[bounty hunter]] [[Asajj Ventress]]. The former [[Sith apprentice]] flew the [[Starship|ship]] during the [[Imperial Era]], using it to travel to the [[planet]] [[Pabu]] during or after [[18 BBY]] to investigate the former [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[special forces]] [[squad]] [[Clone Force 99]].

==Description==
[[File:VentressShipBehind.png|thumb|right|275px|Ventress' ship taking off]]
Ventress' ship was a<ref name="DB" /> [[starfighter]]<ref name="HAD" /> used by<ref name="DB" /> the [[Sith apprentice]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>–turned–[[bounty hunter]] [[Asajj Ventress]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. Primarily [[Color|white]] in color with some darker trim on the wings, the [[Starship|ship]] was 20.3 [[meter]]s wide, with a unique silhouette due to the uneven wings on either side of its 9.1-meter-long fuselage. The longer right side featured a winglet while the shorter left side ended with a squatter wingtip. Three [[engine]]s were arranged on either side of the fuselage for a total of six. Ventress used its [[proton torpedo launcher]]s to evade dangerous [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] entanglements.<ref name="DB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Get in your ship and go. Before we make you.|Wrecker threatens Asajj Ventress|<ref name="Harbinger" />}}
[[File:VentressShipBadBatch.png|thumb|left|290px|Ventress' ship on Pabu]]
During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|309}}</ref> Ventress traveled to<ref name="Harbinger" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Pabu]] after fellow bounty hunter [[Fennec Shand]] alerted her of a [[squad]] of [[Cloning|clones]] known as [[Clone Force 99]] wanting to learn about the Empire's [[Midi-chlorian|M-count]] [[Bounty|bounties]]. Ventress discreetly landed her ship in a [[cave]] at the [[Pabu cove|cove]] on [[Pabu island]] until she was discovered by the clone [[Omega]] and her [[lurca hound]] companion [[Batcher]]. A tentative understanding formed between Ventress and the former [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[Special forces|soldiers]] as the [[Force-sensitive]] assessed Omega's own Force-sensitivity. However, when Omega ran off to retrieve a [[Flower|blossom]] from the [[weeping maya tree]], the clones, who had confirmed that Ventress was a former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[assassin]], confronted Ventress, with the clone [[Wrecker]] telling her to get in her ship and leave before they would force her to. The two parties then fought until Omega returned and convinced her squad to trust Ventress. After Ventress finished working with Omega, she departed Pabu in her ship.<ref name="Harbinger" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ventress' ship first appeared in "[[The Harbinger]],"<ref name="Harbinger" /> the ninth episode in the [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', which premiered on [[March 27]], [[2024]].<ref name="Insider 228">{{InsiderCite|228|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season Three Companion|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season Three Companion}}</ref> The ship was identified in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]].<ref name="DB" /> In the StarWars.com episode guide for "The Harbinger," Ventress' ship was spelled as "Ventress's ship." A lighting concept of the ship was illustrated by artist [[Molly Denmark]] for the production.<ref name="Concept Art">{{SW|url=the-harbinger-concept-art-gallery-star-wars-the-bad-batch|text="The Harbinger" Concept Art Gallery | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref>
